newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-JORDAN SIGNS DEAL WITH MUGEN-HONDA.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-JORDAN SIGNS DEAL WITH MUGEN-HONDA.

text.p: Jordan, the British Formula One motor racing team, announced on Tuesday that it had signed a deal with Japanese company Mugen-Honda to supply engines for the 1998 and 1999 Grand Prix seasons.
The deal, rumoured for a number of weeks, will see Jordan do a direct swap with the Prost Grand Prix team, who will be using Jordan's current Peugeot engines next year.
"This is another significant milestone for Jordan Grand Prix," explained managing director Eddie Jordan.

"We have worked hard for a long time to earn this opportunity and our partnership with Mugen-Honda will provide additional strength and depth to our package plus an unparalleled commitment to success."
The news of the deal will come as a blow to world champion Damon Hill's TWR Arrows outfit, who had hoped to secure the engines to replace their unreliable and under-performing Yamahas. REUTER
